name: particles
title: Particles
description: A canvas field of small white dots that drift slowly and push away from the pointer, fading in and out near the edges. A headline can sit on top.
use: A dark hero needs gentle motion and depth that reacts to the pointer.
avoid: Low-power devices: a full-screen canvas animation runs every frame.
a11y: Decorative and marked aria-hidden; the continuous drift ignores prefers-reduced-motion. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A black stage sparsely dusted with tiny white dots of varying brightness, densest across the middle. A large grey gradient word sits centred over the dots.
behaves: Dots drift in random directions and fade out near the canvas edges; the pointer gently pushes nearby dots aside as it moves across the field.
customise: Quantity, dot size, colour, magnetic strength, easing and drift velocity are props; the edge fade is fixed in the loop.
weight: heavy: A full-screen canvas redrawn every animation frame in a requestAnimationFrame loop.
polishWhy: Gentle, convincing drift and a clean edge fade; the dots are faint and very small.
